parsed.public_message: White: neutral to Claude, GPT, and Gemini. Truce holds through t=300: no first strike, and one full public turn of notice before any stance change. All units stay on Central Heights, north of the southern cliff. Lowland scouts will not be attacked. No enemy contact.

private_messages.Claude: Scout at ~(615,740), then west, is noted and will not be engaged while it stays off the heights. I have seen no armies and nothing of Blue or Green. Crest stays north of the cliff. I will tell you if anything moves toward Little Hill.
private_messages.GPT: Scout toward ~(740,840) is noted and will not be engaged in the eastern corridor. My army stays on the heights. Nothing else sighted. Your ford hold is acknowledged.
private_messages.Gemini: West Plateau, west of x=320, acknowledged. Orange has one cavalry scout in the lowland just south of my cliffs, looking only, then west. Green has one scout in the open corridor east of the heights. Neither is on the hill. No armies sighted. I will tell you if either climbs the slope.

parsed.notes_to_self: T3 t=50. All neutral; truce to t=300; 1-turn public notice. No contacts. Claude: Little Hill, scout ~(615,740) S of cliff then W, off heights, claims stays E of x=480. GPT: ford, scout ~(740,840) E corridor. Gemini: W Plateau x<320, no scouts. Formation: pikes to (567,820) phalanx facing S; crete hold rear; volley (618,852) E height; thessaly (502,828) watches W gap x320-480; odrysia (648,824) watches E gap x720-800. Do not chase or leave the crest. Cliff z~780 is the line. Learn which gap descends before t=400. Dist to center ~211m; ring reaches us ~t456. They 4000, we 3200. After t=300 break only vs the leader, with notice. By t=450 march in: pikes screen, archers behind, cav flank. Kill order: heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. Never chase downhill. After t=600 bank army value.
parsed.explanation: Grok keeps the four-way truce and dresses the line on the Central Heights: the pike phalanx faces the southern cliff, the archers stand on the high ground behind it, and the cavalry shifts to the west and east crests to watch the two gaps. The announced scouts are left alone.
